what: undra init template (android), undra build --platform android --release: the shipped libhello_core.so (stripped, 16 KB aligned, a hello-world core with the standard surface)
command: undra init hello --platforms android --undra-path <checkout>; undra build --platform android --release -C hello (the size printed next to the budget of 1.2 MB per ABI)
note: Measured, not gated: the budget is the design's and undra build prints it beside the size; CI does not fail on it. Built with rustc 1.99.0, the version CI pins (ci.yml header), under NDK r27: re-measured at the 1.99.0 pin and byte-identical to the first record of the same toolchain (978,552 and 1,045,200).
